task: Tell the story of a time you got lost in a city you did not know (120–180 words). Say where you were going, how you felt, and how you found your way.
zh: 讲一个你在陌生城市迷路的故事（120–180 词）。说说你要去哪里、当时的感受，以及最后怎么找到路的。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is working from home better than working in the office? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：在家办公比在办公室办公更好吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of the worst meal you ever cooked (120–180 words). Say what you were trying to make, what went wrong, and what people said.
zh: 讲讲你做过的最失败的一顿饭（120–180 词）。说说你本来想做什么、哪里出了问题，以及别人怎么说。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should children have their own phone before the age of twelve? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：孩子十二岁之前应该有自己的手机吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell a true or invented story about deleting something important by mistake (120–180 words). Say what it was, the moment you noticed, and how it ended.
zh: 讲一个真实或虚构的故事：你不小心删掉了重要的东西（120–180 词）。说说删的是什么、发现的那一刻，以及结局如何。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is it worth paying more for free-range eggs and meat? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：多花钱买散养的鸡蛋和肉值得吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of your first day at your first real job (120–180 words). Include one thing that surprised you.
zh: 讲讲你第一份正式工作第一天的故事（120–180 词）。写出一件让你意外的事。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should shops have to close on public holidays like Good Friday? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：在耶稣受难日这样的公共假日，商店应该必须关门吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a time a stranger helped you (120–180 words). Say what the problem was, what they did, and how you felt afterwards.
zh: 讲一个陌生人帮助你的故事（120–180 词）。说说遇到了什么问题、对方做了什么，以及你事后的感受。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should New Zealand stop using cash? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：新西兰应该停止使用现金吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a sports game you will never forget, as a player or a fan (120–180 words). Describe the most exciting moment.
zh: 讲一场你永远忘不了的体育比赛，可以是你参加的或观看的（120–180 词）。描述最激动人心的时刻。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): are most meetings a waste of time? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：大多数会议都是浪费时间吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of something you bought and later regretted (120–180 words). Say why you bought it and what you did with it in the end.
zh: 讲一件你买了之后后悔的东西（120–180 词）。说说为什么买，以及最后怎么处理的。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should every child learn to code at school? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：每个孩子都应该在学校学编程吗？给出两个理由。

task: Write an invented story (120–180 words): you find a phone on the bus and it starts to ring. Say who is calling and what you do.
zh: 写一个虚构的故事（120–180 词）：你在公交车上捡到一部手机，它突然响了。说说是谁打来的，你怎么做。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is it okay to tell a small lie to protect a friend's feelings? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：为了不伤朋友的心而说个小谎可以吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of your first week in New Zealand (120–180 words). Include one thing that confused you and one thing you loved.
zh: 讲讲你到新西兰第一周的故事（120–180 词）。写出一件让你困惑的事和一件你很喜欢的事。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should buses and trains be free in big cities? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：大城市的公交车和火车应该免费吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a time you were very nervous but did it anyway (120–180 words). Say what it was, how your body felt, and what happened.
zh: 讲一次你非常紧张但还是去做了的经历（120–180 词）。说说是什么事、身体有什么反应，以及结果如何。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is it better to exercise in a gym or outdoors? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：在健身房锻炼好还是在户外锻炼好？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a holiday when everything went wrong (120–180 words). Put the problems in order and say if you can laugh about it now.
zh: 讲一次什么都不顺的假期（120–180 词）。按顺序讲出遇到的问题，并说说现在能不能一笑置之。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): are AI tools making IT jobs better or worse? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：AI 工具让 IT 工作变得更好还是更糟？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a gift you will always remember (120–180 words). Say who gave it to you, when, and why it matters so much.
zh: 讲一件你永远记得的礼物（120–180 词）。说说是谁送的、什么时候，以及它为什么这么重要。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should companies try a four-day working week? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：公司应该试行每周四天工作制吗？给出两个理由。

task: Write an invented story (120–180 words): you are stuck in a lift with your boss for one hour. Say what you talk about and how it changes things at work.
zh: 写一个虚构的故事（120–180 词）：你和老板被困在电梯里一个小时。说说你们聊了什么，以及这对工作有什么影响。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is it better to have a few close friends or many friends? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：有几个知心朋友好，还是有很多朋友好？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a funny misunderstanding you had because of English (120–180 words). Say what you heard, what the person really meant, and what happened next.
zh: 讲一个因为英语而闹出的有趣误会（120–180 词）。说说你听成了什么、对方真正的意思，以及后来怎么样。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should overseas tourists pay to enter New Zealand's national parks? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：外国游客进入新西兰国家公园应该收费吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell a true or invented story about the worst flatmate or neighbour you ever had (120–180 words). Give one clear example of what they did.
zh: 讲一个真实或虚构的故事：你遇到过的最糟糕的室友或邻居（120–180 词）。举一个具体例子说明他们做了什么。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is eating out at restaurants a waste of money? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：去餐厅吃饭是浪费钱吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of learning a new skill as an adult, such as swimming or driving (120–180 words). Say what was hardest and when it finally worked.
zh: 讲讲你成年后学一项新技能的经历，比如游泳或开车（120–180 词）。说说最难的是什么，以及什么时候终于学会了。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): should people be able to take a sick day when they feel very stressed? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：人在压力特别大的时候，应该可以请病假吗？给出两个理由。

task: Write an invented story (120–180 words): you wake up and can speak perfect English, but only for one day. Say how you spend the day.
zh: 写一个虚构的故事（120–180 词）：你一觉醒来能说完美的英语，但只有一天。说说你怎么度过这一天。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is shopping online better than going to the shops? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：网上购物比去实体店更好吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a time you had to say no to someone (120–180 words). Say what they asked, why it was hard, and how they took it.
zh: 讲一次你不得不拒绝别人的经历（120–180 词）。说说对方提了什么要求、为什么难开口，以及对方的反应。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is it better to repair old things or to buy new ones? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：旧东西是修好继续用，还是买新的更好？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a visit to a dentist or hospital that you remember well (120–180 words). Say why you went and what the staff were like.
zh: 讲一次你印象很深的看牙或去医院的经历（120–180 词）。说说为什么去，以及医护人员怎么样。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): does a good IT manager need to be a technical expert? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：好的 IT 经理需要是技术专家吗？给出两个理由。

task: Tell the story of a time you were proud of your team (120–180 words). Say what the goal was, what each person did, and how it ended.
zh: 讲一次你为自己的团队感到骄傲的经历（120–180 词）。说说目标是什么、每个人做了什么，以及结果如何。

task: Give your opinion (120–180 words): is social media good for friendships? Give two reasons.
zh: 说说你的看法（120–180 词）：社交媒体对友谊有好处吗？给出两个理由。
